title: 1%银幕：撬动6%票房，影院会跟进吗？
speaker: Daniel Munwaring

segments.en: Yeah. I think the story of the summer here is really premium.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为今年暑期档的关键词是‘高端化’。

segments.en: I mean, audiences are becoming more and more particular and picky about what they want to watch and the formats for which they want to watch it.
segments.zh: 观众对想看的内容和观影格式越来越挑剔。

segments.en: One interesting stat is premium formats are up 16% year over year, whereas regular auditoriums are pretty much flat.
segments.zh: 一个有趣的数据是，高端格式票房同比增长16%，而普通影厅基本持平。

segments.en: Obviously, we would make up a big majority of that. Our market share over the summer grew all to just under 6%, about 5.9%, totaling $110 million.
segments.zh: 我们占据了其中的大部分。暑期市场份额增长至接近6%，约5.9%，总票房达1.1亿美元。

segments.en: And that's all on less than 1% of the total screens in China.
segments.zh: 而这仅靠中国不到1%的银幕数量实现。

segments.en: So audiences are being very particular about what they want, they're deciding what they want, and then they're willing to go and spend the money for what they want.
segments.zh: 观众非常明确自己的需求，一旦决定，就愿意为之付费。
